hydraulicModel.assetStrategy: time-based one-hour crest release over precomputed one-foot-grid hydraulic lookups

scenarioMethod: Mean uses NOAA TWL90p minus 0.25 ft before dated tide anchoring. Minimum is exactly two inches below the final Mean in both datums. Maximum retains the existing normal lower-tail p25 estimate minus 0.25 ft. NOAA bias is retained and raw NOAA forecasts are preserved separately.
meanTideAnchorMethod: Dated manual Mean crests in feet MLLW. Each rise and fall is scaled about its adjacent low tide; peak times and low tides are preserved. Minimum follows two inches below the anchored Mean. Maximum is unchanged.
